protocol.purpose: Estimate approximate finite-dimensional scaling, without treating non-rejection as proof of self-similarity.
protocol.support: Within each regime, every origin with two times the largest lag of uninterrupted segment support; identical flights and origins at every lag.
protocol.weighting: Uniform within each flight across its eligible origins, then equal flight weights.
protocol.training_split: SHA256 of temporal-scaling-v1:YYYY-MM-DD has even first byte. Entire calendar dates share a role across both disciplines. Invalid dates are excluded and counted.
protocol.fit: Training-only inverse-CDF quantiles of absolute E, absolute N, and radius at probabilities 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9. Common H is the unweighted mean of the 12 log-log slopes. Histograms have 8192 logarithmic bins from 1e-6 to 1e7 metres, plus zero and overflow bins; report resolution and reject quantiles outside finite bins.
protocol.normalization: One common H and one scalar length: the training radial median at the smallest lag. No lag-specific centering, whitening, rotation, or marginal normalization.
protocol.projections: Four coordinate axes and all twelve normalized pairwise sums and differences in R4, fixed before measurement.
protocol.error: Maximum absolute probability difference over every pair of lags, the fixed thresholds and indicated projections, measured on held-out dates.
protocol.uncertainty: 999 paired calendar-date bootstrap replicates. Simultaneous 95% band on all signed lag-pair differences within a discipline and regime, conditional on training fit. Date clusters assumed independent; pilot dependence across dates may remain.
protocol.interpretation: An upper bound below a tolerance supports approximate agreement at this diagnostic resolution only; these finite projections and two consecutive intervals cannot establish full process self-similarity or stationarity.
